H2 uptake measured in a gravimetric device (ICB-CSIC, VTI microbalance, buoyancy correction stated) and in two volumetric devices (IJL, ICMPE, Sieverts method) on anthracite-derived activated carbons (M1149 to T3220); Table 2 gives uptake in wt% at 77 K and 4 MPa and at 298 K and 5 MPa.
